prompt_inputs.goal: muscle recovery and strength building for a vegetarian endurance athlete
prompt_inputs.restrictions: lactose intolerant, no animal products except eggs

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly one full day with 4-5 meals/snacks
All meals are vegetarian, lactose-free, and accommodate stated restrictions
Provides high protein intake appropriate for muscle recovery (minimum 1.6g per kg body weight)
Maintains balanced macronutrient ratios suitable for athletic performance
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a specialized athlete requiring high-protein intake and specific macronutrient ratios for muscle recovery, including dietary restrictions (e.g., lactose intolerance) and food preferences (e.g., vegetarian)
